name: auth-better-auth
description: Better Auth — framework-agnostic auth, email/password enabled, ready for a DB adapter.
docs: Better Auth instance with email/password enabled. Add a database adapter (drizzleAdapter / prismaAdapter from better-auth/adapters) bound to your db package before production — without one it falls back to in-memory storage. Generate the auth schema with `bunx @better-auth/cli generate`.
